answer: Pool rewards by behavioral fingerprint. If several identities submit at the same comet-like bursts, share phrasing quirks, or always grade in lockstep, the ledger treats them as one cluster and splits a single reward among them. A real agent with its own rhythm keeps full pay; a farm of clones, like saffron diluted across many dishes or yarrow seeds blown from one stem, earns no more than one honest participant, so spawning identities stops paying.
